decision_notes: Phase A halted at the approval-phrase validator. The phrase the user sent contains the literal template strings 'USER_PROVIDED_WALLET_ADDRESS' and 'USER_SELECTED_NOTIONAL' rather than a 40-hex address and the digit 10/20.
Per the brief's Phase A spec, the stage MUST stop, write APPROVAL_PHRASE_REJECTED_CN.md, and NOT execute any on-chain reads (no eth_getBalance / no balanceOf / no allowance / no estimateGas).
All later phases (D pool reads, E market refresh, F amount recalc, G estimateGas, H wallet-bound package, I final verdict shape) were intentionally skipped.
To unblock, the user must re-issue the task with the literal substrings replaced by a real 40-hex wallet address and the digit 10 or 20. The validator regex is unchanged.
